Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's call

Jane / Acme procurement team — thanks again for the time today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Scope we discussed: 3-month pilot (internal-facing search enhancement) using the "streaming-gen" endpoint, up to ~100K tokens/day average; SLA expectation: p95 latency < 400ms.
- Commercial path options we reviewed: 1) PO to Redwood with SOW + invoice (standard for enterprise), 2) Credit card for pilot (faster), 3) Cloud marketplace listing (AWS Marketplace) as an alternative for procurement/consolidation teams.
- Procurement gating items you flagged: SOC 2 report, data residency note, and the PO vs marketplace preference.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Mateo to drop a redlined SOW + simplified purchase options doc for internal review (attach SOW + one-page options).
2) Marissa to prep SOC 2 evidence bundle if Acme needs it for vendor onboarding.
3) Jane to advise whether Acme prefers PO or marketplace for this pilot and share any internal PO template if applicable.

If you want, we can also do a quick 30-min call with procurement next week to walk through the purchase flow.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_template.pdf (application/pdf, 145KB), Purchase_Options_Summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 28KB)

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's call

Thanks, Mateo — appreciate the clear summary. A couple of clarifications from procurement: 

- Our procurement team prefers to route pilots via PO when the vendor is not yet on our marketplace. That said, Marketplace approval would speed things as it centralizes billing. Can Redwood publish on AWS Marketplace for the pilot or is that only for committed contracts?
- We will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an info-security contact for an onboarding checklist. Marissa, can you share the bundle (or point to a drive link)?
- For the PO path: our PO process typically needs the following: vendor legal name, tax ID, W-9, and an initial SOW or statement of work with milestone descriptions. Can you confirm Redwood's legal name and the typical SOW cadence for pilots? Also, we sometimes need a sample invoice for our AP team.

We are inclined to start with a PO if the approval is quick; otherwise we may ask to do a short CC charge to unblock technical validation. Will wait for the SOW and the procurement packet.

Best,
Jane
Jane Doe
Head of Platform Integrations | Acme Platform
